transcript.en_text: ...a longstanding source...
transcript.zh_text: ...一个长期存在的根源...

transcript.en_text: Underwood will speak before the committee today regarding the allegations...
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德今天将在委员会前就这些指控发言...

transcript.en_text: While little is being released to the public, the vice president's statement...
transcript.zh_text: 虽然向公众披露的信息很少，但副总统的声明...

transcript.en_text: The vice president just entered the Department of Justice.
transcript.zh_text: 副总统刚刚进入司法部。

transcript.en_text: We're here with Ayla Sayyad, whose Wall Street Telegraph article catalyzed the investigation. Ayla.
transcript.zh_text: 我们和艾拉·萨亚德在一起，她的《华尔街电讯报》文章促成了这项调查。艾拉。

transcript.en_text: The issue at stake is whether the White House was in any way involved.
transcript.zh_text: 关键问题是白宫是否以任何方式参与其中。

transcript.en_text: Was foreign money traded for political favors?
transcript.zh_text: 外国资金是否被用来换取政治恩惠？

transcript.en_text: Did it influence diplomatic relations?
transcript.zh_text: 它是否影响了外交关系？

transcript.en_text: Just the act of laundering Chinese contributions is illegal.
transcript.zh_text: 仅仅是洗钱中国捐款的行为就是非法的。

transcript.en_text: If it had a significant impact on White House policy, that's a far more serious crime.
transcript.zh_text: 如果它对白宫政策产生了重大影响，那将是更严重的罪行。

transcript.en_text: You've met with Daniel Lanagin on multiple occasions.
transcript.zh_text: 你曾多次与丹尼尔·拉纳金会面。

transcript.en_text: We were in the same room, yes, on 11 occasions since 2003.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，自2003年以来，我们曾有11次在同一个房间里。

transcript.en_text: But we only spoke on three of those occasions.
transcript.zh_text: 但我们只在其中三次场合交谈过。

transcript.en_text: - Those instances are highlighted. - What did you discuss?
transcript.zh_text: - 那些情况都被标出。 - 你们讨论了什么？

transcript.en_text: These were fund-raisers. I speak to dozens of people.
transcript.zh_text: 这些都是筹款活动。我与几十个人交谈。

transcript.en_text: Usually about nothing at all. I'm Southern, Ms. Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 通常什么都没说。我是南方人，邓巴女士。

transcript.en_text: My mother taught me that conversation during mealtime is not only polite, it aids the digestive process.
transcript.zh_text: 我母亲教导我，用餐时的交谈不仅礼貌，还有助于消化过程。

transcript.en_text: So you didn't speak to him about the Adohi Tribe's contributions - to any of these super PACS? - Absolutely not.
transcript.zh_text: 所以你没有和他谈论阿多希部落对这些超级政治行动委员会的捐款吗？——绝无此事。

transcript.en_text: I never discuss super PACs with any supporters. We both know the law.
transcript.zh_text: 我从不与任何支持者讨论超级政治行动委员会。我们都懂法律。

transcript.en_text: During one of these polite conversations, do you recall Mr. Lanagin ever mentioning Xander Feng?
transcript.zh_text: 在这些客套的谈话中，你是否记得拉纳金先生曾提及桑德·冯？

transcript.en_text: - I do not. - Does that name mean anything to you?
transcript.zh_text: - 我不知道。- 那个名字对你来说有什么特别的意义吗？

highlights.zh_word: 对你来说有什么特别的意义

transcript.en_text: Other than being plastered all over the news?
transcript.zh_text: 除了在新闻上铺天盖地地出现？

transcript.en_text: In that regard, it means as much as Kim Kardashian.
transcript.zh_text: 就那方面而言，它就像金·卡戴珊这个名字一样，没什么特别。

transcript.en_text: Then let me be more specific. What knowledge do you have of Mr. Feng's political activities?
transcript.zh_text: 那让我说得更具体些。你对冯先生的政治活动有什么了解？

transcript.en_text: - Is this coming from your husband, or is it...? - From me.
transcript.zh_text: - 这是你丈夫的意思，还是...？- 是我的意思。

transcript.en_text: And it's not that I don't support the bill anymore.
transcript.zh_text: 我不是说我不再支持这项法案了。

transcript.en_text: It's just the article.
transcript.zh_text: 只是那篇文章。

transcript.en_text: We've promised Matt an interview.
transcript.zh_text: 我们已经答应马特一个采访了。

transcript.en_text: Maybe in a few weeks, once the investigation has died down.
transcript.zh_text: 也许再过几周，等调查平息下来后。

transcript.en_text: The New York Times isn't going to wait for us.
transcript.zh_text: 《纽约时报》可不会等我们。

transcript.en_text: They've already scheduled the cover for October, based on our timing...
transcript.zh_text: 他们已经根据我们的时间安排，把十月份的封面排好了...

transcript.en_text: Then I can't be a part of it.
transcript.zh_text: 那我就不能参与其中了。

transcript.en_text: - It's the Galloway nonsense, isn't it? - Claire, come on.
transcript.zh_text: - 是关于加洛韦的那些胡言乱语，对吗？- 克莱尔，别这样。

transcript.en_text: It's OK. You can say so. We're friends.
transcript.zh_text: 没关系。你可以直说。我们是朋友。

transcript.en_text: - It doesn't help. - You don't actually believe...
transcript.zh_text: - 这没有帮助。- 你不会真的相信...

transcript.en_text: No.
transcript.zh_text: 不。

transcript.en_text: But enough of the country still does.
transcript.zh_text: 但国家仍有足够多的人相信。

transcript.en_text: And Garrett needs every bit of support he can get right now.
transcript.zh_text: 加勒特现在需要他能得到的一切支持。

transcript.en_text: So there's no convincing you?
transcript.zh_text: 所以你是无法被说服了？

transcript.en_text: I'll help you as much as I can, quietly.
transcript.zh_text: 我会尽我所能地帮助你，悄悄地。

transcript.en_text: There are rumors that you and Mr. Feng served as back channels - to the trade summit last May. - Exactly. Rumors.
transcript.zh_text: 有传言说您和冯先生在去年五月的贸易峰会中担任了秘密渠道——没错，是传言。

transcript.en_text: We have Feng in the US during the summit.
transcript.zh_text: 峰会期间，冯先生在美国。

transcript.en_text: If he was back-channeling, and even if I were aware, any form of diplomatic communication is usually classified.
transcript.zh_text: 即使他真的在进行秘密沟通，即使我知情，任何形式的外交沟通通常都是机密的。

transcript.en_text: Have you ever discussed Feng with the president?
transcript.zh_text: 您和总统讨论过冯先生吗？

transcript.en_text: Any major player in Beijing is worthy of discussion.
transcript.zh_text: 任何北京的重要人物都值得讨论。

transcript.en_text: - So that's a yes. - It's a general comment.
transcript.zh_text: ——那就是了。——这只是一个笼统的评论。

transcript.en_text: Did you discuss him during the energy crisis?
transcript.zh_text: 在能源危机期间你们讨论过他吗？

transcript.en_text: I assume you're alluding to his refinery co-venture...
transcript.zh_text: 我想你指的是他炼油厂的合资企业……

transcript.en_text: - Yes, with Raymond Tusk. - The refinery was never part of our conversation.
transcript.zh_text: ——是的，和雷蒙德·塔斯克。——炼油厂从未在我们谈话范围之内。

transcript.en_text: We needed an immediate solution. A refinery would've solved nothing in the short term.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要一个即时解决方案。炼油厂在短期内解决不了任何问题。

transcript.en_text: And it's my understanding that deal fell through.
transcript.zh_text: 据我所知，那笔交易失败了。

transcript.en_text: Correct. But Tusk did receive a subsidy.
transcript.zh_text: 没错。但塔斯克确实获得了一笔补贴。

transcript.en_text: As did every other nuclear energy provider.
transcript.zh_text: 其他所有核能供应商也一样。

transcript.en_text: But his connection with Feng, then a subsidy on samarium...
transcript.zh_text: 但他与冯先生的联系，然后是钐的补贴……

transcript.en_text: Nobody made any profits off these subsidies. At best they're breaking even.
transcript.zh_text: 没人从这些补贴中获利。充其量他们只是收支平衡。

transcript.en_text: In fact, Raymond fought us on the issue.
transcript.zh_text: 事实上，雷蒙德在这个问题上反对我们。

transcript.en_text: Then let's back up to the Port Jefferson Bridge.
transcript.zh_text: 那我们回到杰斐逊港大桥。

transcript.en_text: Subtitles by MemoryOnSmells http://UKsubtitles.ru.
transcript.zh_text: 字幕由MemoryOnSmells提供 http://UKsubtitles.ru。

transcript.en_text: I don't blame her. It's a valid concern.
transcript.zh_text: 我不怪她。这是一个合理的担忧。

transcript.en_text: Tell him I won't engage on Galloway, so there's no point in asking.
transcript.zh_text: 告诉他我不会参与关于加洛韦的讨论，所以没必要问了。

transcript.en_text: This is Matt Bai, we can't dictate what he'll ask. And he will ask.
transcript.zh_text: 这是马特·白，我们不能左右他会问什么。而且他一定会问。

transcript.en_text: Then I'll just say I won't answer tabloid questions.
transcript.zh_text: 那我就说，我不会回答那些八卦小报的问题。

transcript.en_text: It's a legitimate question, how the scandal could affect the vote.
transcript.zh_text: 这是一个合理的问题，丑闻会如何影响投票。

transcript.en_text: Look, I say you pull out too. We scrap the whole piece.
transcript.zh_text: 听着，我说你也退出吧。我们把整篇文章都作废。

transcript.en_text: Jackie's fighting us. The leadership is noncommittal.
transcript.zh_text: 杰基在对抗我们。领导层不表态。

transcript.en_text: We need this article to refocus attention.
transcript.zh_text: 我们希望通过这篇文章来重新聚焦注意力。

transcript.en_text: But it'll hurt you, both your personal image and the bill.
transcript.zh_text: 但这会伤害你，无论是你的个人形象还是法案。

transcript.en_text: But if we cut the cord, we schedule two interviews then we cancel, won't Matt be furious? The story will be about pulling out.
transcript.zh_text: 但如果我们切断联系，安排了两次采访又取消，马特不会大发雷霆吗？新闻会变成我们退出这件事。

transcript.en_text: We're talking about the lesser of two evils.
transcript.zh_text: 我们在谈论两害相权取其轻。

transcript.en_text: I don't want you to become the target, to undo all...
transcript.zh_text: 我不想你成为靶子，去毁掉所有……

transcript.en_text: Then what if it's not me at all?
transcript.zh_text: 那如果根本不是我呢？

transcript.en_text: - You said the First Lady wasn't... - Not her. Someone else.
transcript.zh_text: - 你说第一夫人不是…… - 不是她。是别人。

transcript.en_text: Was the bridge a trade-off to prevent additional GOP funding?
transcript.zh_text: 这座桥是为了阻止共和党获得额外资金而做出的权衡吗？

transcript.en_text: As far as I know, the bridge was a delivery on a promise the president had made to the voters. Are we finished here?
transcript.zh_text: 据我所知，这座桥是总统兑现他对选民承诺的表现。我们谈完了吗？

transcript.en_text: Almost.
transcript.zh_text: 差不多了。

transcript.en_text: How many members of Congress have you interviewed, Ms. Dunbar? About 200?
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴女士，你采访过多少国会议员？大概200个？

transcript.en_text: - One hundred ninety-four. - I want to be of help, but I doubt I can offer any more than the 194 that preceded me.
transcript.zh_text: - 194个。 - 我想帮忙，但我怀疑我能提供的不会比那194位在我之前的人更多。

transcript.en_text: - I have gotten some useful testimony. - From who?
transcript.zh_text: - 我得到了一些有用的证词。 - 从谁那里？

transcript.en_text: - A high-ranking House member. - In the leadership?
transcript.zh_text: - 一位高级众议院成员。 - 是领导层的人吗？

transcript.en_text: - I'm not at liberty to say. - Bob Birch? Jackie Sharp?
transcript.zh_text: - 我不便透露。 - 鲍勃·伯奇？杰基·夏普？

transcript.en_text: This individual says he attended a meeting, July 14th, in the Oval Office.
transcript.zh_text: 这个人说他参加了7月14日在椭圆形办公室的一次会议。

transcript.en_text: She said "he." So it must have been Birch.
transcript.zh_text: 她说的是“他”。那一定是伯奇。

transcript.en_text: I'm sure Raymond had no trouble buying him off.
transcript.zh_text: 我相信雷蒙德很容易就买通了他。

transcript.en_text: You attended that meeting also.
transcript.zh_text: 你也参加了那次会议。

transcript.en_text: - It appears so. - You recall the subject of that meeting?
transcript.zh_text: - 好像是。 - 你还记得那次会议的主题吗？

transcript.en_text: A wave of conservative attack ads. We were being outspent.
transcript.zh_text: 一波保守派攻击性广告。我们的开销被超越了。

transcript.en_text: It must have been quite a shock when Lanagin's tribe shifted contributions to the other party, when they hadn't given a single dime to the Republicans before that.
transcript.zh_text: 兰纳金的部落把捐款转移到另一个政党，而在此之前他们从未给共和党捐过一分钱，这一定是个巨大的冲击。

transcript.en_text: It would've been a shock, but we didn't know where the money was coming from.
transcript.zh_text: 这会是个打击，但我们不知道钱是从哪里来的。

transcript.en_text: - According to my source... - Bob Birch.
transcript.zh_text: - 根据我的消息来源... - 鲍勃·伯奇。

transcript.en_text: My source says the estimate was 25 million.
transcript.zh_text: 我的消息来源说估计是2500万。

transcript.en_text: You said, and I quote: "With this kind of influx, you can be sure somebody isn't playing by the rules."
transcript.zh_text: 你说，我引用一下原话：“有这种资金涌入，你可以肯定有人没有按规矩办事。”

transcript.en_text: Sounds like something I might say. Bob has a better memory than me.
transcript.zh_text: 听起来像是我会说的话。鲍勃的记性比我好。

transcript.en_text: The money stopped just after the Port Jefferson Bridge was approved.
transcript.zh_text: 钱在杰弗逊港大桥获批后就停了。

transcript.en_text: Is there a theory here, or are you just grasping at straws?
transcript.zh_text: 这背后有什么理论吗，还是你只是在徒劳挣扎？

transcript.en_text: The bridge leads to Feng. Feng gives me Lanagin and Tusk.
transcript.zh_text: 这座桥通向冯。冯牵扯出兰纳金和塔斯克。

transcript.en_text: - Tusk and the President... - Ms. Dunbar, you want to play six degrees of separation, you could throw in Jimmy Hoffa and the pope.
transcript.zh_text: - 塔斯克和总统... - 邓巴女士，如果你想玩“六度分隔理论”，你可以把吉米·霍法和教皇也扯进来。

transcript.en_text: How about one degree of separation.
transcript.zh_text: 那就“一度分隔”如何。

transcript.en_text: Douglas Stamper, your chief of staff.
transcript.zh_text: 道格拉斯·斯坦普，你的幕僚长。

transcript.en_text: This is him at Lanagin's casino, July 14th.
transcript.zh_text: 这是他7月14日在兰纳金赌场拍的。

transcript.en_text: I used these to get a warrant for flight records.
transcript.zh_text: 我用这些来获取飞行记录的搜查令。

transcript.en_text: The next day, Mr. Stamper was on a flight to Beijing.
transcript.zh_text: 第二天，斯坦珀先生搭机飞往北京。

transcript.en_text: Why was he at the casino? And why was he in Beijing?
transcript.zh_text: 他为什么会在赌场？又为什么会去北京？

transcript.en_text: - I would like to speak to my client. - Please.
transcript.zh_text: - 我想和我的客户谈谈。 - 请便。

transcript.en_text: I work hard.
transcript.zh_text: 我工作很努力。

transcript.en_text: I keep things simple. I know what my priorities are.
transcript.zh_text: 我把事情简单化。我知道我的重点是什么。

transcript.en_text: But there's this... this person.
transcript.zh_text: 但有这么一个人……

transcript.en_text: She's not even in my life, except on the edges making things blurrier.
transcript.zh_text: 她甚至不在我的生活中，只是在边缘让一切变得模糊不清。

transcript.en_text: It doesn't tempt me to drink. It's more like she...
transcript.zh_text: 这不会引诱我喝酒。更像是她……

transcript.en_text: More like she feels what it was like when I was drinking.
transcript.zh_text: 更像是她感受到了我以前喝酒时的那种感觉。

transcript.en_text: When I couldn't get enough.
transcript.zh_text: 当我无法满足的时候。

transcript.en_text: No matter how many drinks I had, I wanted another.
transcript.zh_text: 不管我喝了多少杯，我都还想再来一杯。

transcript.en_text: I don't want to be with her.
transcript.zh_text: 我不想和她在一起。

transcript.en_text: I mean, I do.
transcript.zh_text: 我的意思是，我确实想。

transcript.en_text: But...
transcript.zh_text: 但是……

transcript.en_text: ...it's more like she's my daughter.
transcript.zh_text: ……更像是她是我的女儿。

transcript.en_text: Or my mother. I don't know, this is fucked up.
transcript.zh_text: 或者是我的母亲。我不知道，这真是糟糕透了。

transcript.en_text: Take your time.
transcript.zh_text: 慢慢来。

transcript.en_text: I should cut her off, the way I did with booze.
transcript.zh_text: 我应该和她断绝关系，就像我戒酒一样。

transcript.en_text: That's all. I'm done.
transcript.zh_text: 就这样。我说完了。

transcript.en_text: - Thanks for sharing. - Thanks for sharing.
transcript.zh_text: - 谢谢分享。 - 谢谢分享。

transcript.en_text: We'll need time before responding to your questions.
transcript.zh_text: 我们需要时间来回答你的问题。

transcript.en_text: - I can wait as long as necessary. - It could take a while.
transcript.zh_text: - 只要有必要，我可以等。- 可能需要一段时间。

transcript.en_text: There are national security matters at stake.
transcript.zh_text: 国家安全事务事关重大。

transcript.en_text: The vice president needs to consult with his advisors.
transcript.zh_text: 副总统需要咨询他的顾问。

transcript.en_text: National security? Are you really going - to play that card, Oliver? - His answers could entail classified material.
transcript.zh_text: 国家安全？奥利弗，你真要打那张牌吗？他的回答可能涉及机密材料。

transcript.en_text: - When can we expect a response? - I'll let you know.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们什么时候能收到回复？- 我会通知你。

transcript.en_text: - May we hold onto the screen cap? - Be my guest.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们可以保留这张截屏吗？- 请便。

transcript.en_text: - We'll be in touch soon, Ms. Dunbar. - Mr. Vice President.
transcript.zh_text: - 邓巴女士，我们很快会联系您。- 副总统先生。

transcript.en_text: If you think you're insulated, don't.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你以为自己能置身事外，那就错了。

transcript.en_text: Our investigation is much bigger than Douglas Stamper.
transcript.zh_text: 我们的调查远比道格拉斯·斯坦普尔要大。

transcript.en_text: - That's enough, Ms. Dunbar. - Thank you for your time, Mr. Vice President.
transcript.zh_text: - 够了，邓巴女士。- 感谢您抽出时间，副总统先生。

transcript.en_text: Happy to cooperate.
transcript.zh_text: 乐意合作。

transcript.en_text: From the lion's den to a pack of wolves.
transcript.zh_text: 从狮子窝到狼群。

transcript.en_text: When you're fresh meat, kill and throw them something fresher.
transcript.zh_text: 当你成为“案板上的肉”时，要杀出重围，抛出更“新鲜”的筹码。

transcript.en_text: Hey, I'm Fitz.
transcript.zh_text: 嘿，我是菲兹。

transcript.en_text: Doug.
transcript.zh_text: 道格。

transcript.en_text: You know, you can isolate, white-knuckle this shit if you want.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道，如果你想，你可以把自己孤立起来，咬牙坚持这件事。

transcript.en_text: Or you can ask for help. You got a sponsor?
transcript.zh_text: 或者你可以寻求帮助。你有没有戒酒互助会的赞助人？

transcript.en_text: No, it's been 14 years. I'm good.
transcript.zh_text: 不，已经14年了。我没事。

transcript.en_text: Number's on the back if you change your mind.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你改变主意，号码在背面。

transcript.en_text: I thought you had a driver.
transcript.zh_text: 我以为你有个司机。

transcript.en_text: I do, but I didn't want him overhearing anything.
transcript.zh_text: 我确实有，但我不想他偷听任何事。

transcript.en_text: - You shouldn't even be near this state. - I'm not really here.
transcript.zh_text: - 你不该靠近这个州。- 我不算是真的在这儿。

transcript.en_text: Long layover on my way to California.
transcript.zh_text: 只是去加州的漫长中途停留。

transcript.en_text: I've got auditors, federal agents, in my office going through every file, every document, they're going through my goddamn trash.
transcript.zh_text: 我办公室里有审计员，联邦探员，他们正在查阅我的每个文件，每份资料，他们甚至在翻我的那些该死的垃圾。

transcript.en_text: Just stick to the Fifth if she subpoenas you.
transcript.zh_text: 如果她传唤你，你就坚持援引第五修正案。

transcript.en_text: How did they know to look for Stamper? To search the tapes on that exact day?
transcript.zh_text: 他们怎么知道要找斯坦普？怎么知道要搜查那天录像带？

transcript.en_text: - Don't jump to conclusions. - You're throwing me under the bus.
transcript.zh_text: - 别急于下结论。- 你这是要陷害我。

transcript.en_text: Underwood's the roadkill, not you.
transcript.zh_text: 安德伍德是替罪羊，不是你。

transcript.en_text: They're going to fuck me.
transcript.zh_text: 他们会把我搞垮的。

transcript.en_text: They'll find a way. You know that.
transcript.zh_text: 他们总会找到办法的。你知道的。

transcript.en_text: And if that's the case, you and your family will be taken care of.
transcript.zh_text: 如果真是那样，你和你的家人都会得到妥善照顾。

transcript.en_text: They're already offering me a plea.
transcript.zh_text: 他们已经在向我提供认罪协议了。

transcript.en_text: You haven't even been charged yet.
transcript.zh_text: 你甚至都还没被起诉呢。

transcript.en_text: - If I cooperate. - You'll do less time. But your family will have nothing.
transcript.zh_text: - 如果我合作。- 你会少坐牢。但你家人将一无所有。

transcript.en_text: They'll still have nothing when you get out.
transcript.zh_text: 你出来后他们仍然一无所有。

transcript.en_text: You testify against Raymond and he'll still walk, because all they'll have is your word, and that doesn't count for much right now.
transcript.zh_text: 你去作证指控雷蒙德，他还是会逍遥法外，因为他们只有你的口供，而那现在不值什么钱。

transcript.en_text: You wouldn't be here if he wasn't afraid.
transcript.zh_text: 如果他没害怕，你就不会在这儿。

transcript.en_text: I'm not here because he's afraid. I'm here because you are.
transcript.zh_text: 我不是因为他害怕才来，我是因为你害怕才来。

transcript.en_text: And I want to make sure you don't do anything stupid.
transcript.zh_text: 我要确保你别做任何蠢事。

transcript.en_text: After repeated conversations with Beijing, they remain intractable in their position.
transcript.zh_text: 与北京反复交涉后，他们立场依然强硬，不肯让步。

transcript.en_text: This morning I gave orders for a carrier group to reposition near Okinawa.
transcript.zh_text: 今天早上，我下令一个航母战斗群重新部署到冲绳附近。

transcript.en_text: This won't put our ships in direct confrontation with the Chinese vessels, but it will put them within reach of air strikes.
transcript.zh_text: 这不会让我们的舰船与中国船只直接对抗，但会使其处于空袭范围内。

transcript.en_text: I'll be informing the Chinese ambassador later today.
transcript.zh_text: 我今天晚些时候会通知中国大使。

transcript.en_text: We'll release a statement in coordination with the Pentagon.
transcript.zh_text: 我们将与五角大楼协调发布一份声明。

transcript.en_text: Sir, our stockpiles of samarium will only last another two months at most.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，我们的钐储备最多只能再维持两个月了。

transcript.en_text: - If we go this route... - I've heard everyone's concerns, and this is the decision I've made. Any questions?
transcript.zh_text: - 如果我们走这条路……- 我已经听取了大家的顾虑，这是我做出的决定。还有问题吗？

transcript.en_text: OK. Thank you.
transcript.zh_text: 好的。谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Frank.
transcript.zh_text: 弗兰克。

transcript.en_text: My deputy briefed me on the latest.
transcript.zh_text: 我的副手向我汇报了最新情况。

transcript.en_text: How did it go?
transcript.zh_text: 进展如何？

transcript.en_text: We have a few follow-up questions we have to address.
transcript.zh_text: 我们有一些后续问题需要处理。

transcript.en_text: - Like what? - Nothing major.
transcript.zh_text: - 比如什么？- 没什么大事。

transcript.en_text: Just odds and ends, a few details.
transcript.zh_text: 只是一些零碎小事，几个细节。

transcript.en_text: I was under the impression this would be short and sweet.
transcript.zh_text: 我原以为这会很快很顺利地结束。

transcript.en_text: So was I. But she's very deliberate.
transcript.zh_text: 我也这么认为。但她非常深思熟虑。

transcript.en_text: We need this over, Frank, at least as far as the White House is concerned.
transcript.zh_text: 弗兰克，我们需要把这件事了结，至少就白宫而言是这样。

transcript.en_text: We can't be distracted. Not with warships on the move.
transcript.zh_text: 我们不能分心。尤其是在军舰调动的时候。

transcript.en_text: I'm confident we're in the homestretch.
transcript.zh_text: 我相信我们已经进入了最后阶段。

transcript.en_text: You seem more concerned than you're letting on.
transcript.zh_text: 你看起来比你表现出来的要更担心。

transcript.en_text: - Oh, no. Not at all. - You're fidgeting.
transcript.zh_text: - 哦，不，一点也没有。- 你在坐立不安。

transcript.en_text: Oh...
It's my class ring. I forget I...
transcript.zh_text: 是我的毕业戒指。我忘了我……

transcript.en_text: - I buried it. - You what?
transcript.zh_text: - 我把它埋了。- 你说什么？

transcript.en_text: I... It's a long story.
transcript.zh_text: 我……说来话长。

transcript.en_text: I've never seen you this stressed before, Frank.
transcript.zh_text: 弗兰克，我以前从没见过你这么紧张。

transcript.en_text: Well, I've never seen you this tired before, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，我也从没见过您这么疲惫。

transcript.en_text: You've got rings of your own, dark ones.
transcript.zh_text: 您也有自己的“黑眼圈”，而且很深。

transcript.en_text: They're getting worse, aren't they?
transcript.zh_text: 它们越来越严重了，不是吗？

transcript.en_text: You should take more naps on those sofas in the Oval.
transcript.zh_text: 您应该在椭圆形办公室的沙发上多睡会儿午觉。

transcript.en_text: Naps don't cut it these days, Frank. Not even a dent.
transcript.zh_text: 弗兰克，如今午睡也解决不了问题了。一点用都没有。

transcript.en_text: Lie after lie.
transcript.zh_text: 谎言一个接一个。

transcript.en_text: First to a prosecutor, then to a president.
transcript.zh_text: 先是对检察官，然后是对总统。

transcript.en_text: I feel exposed, like the skin where my ring used to be.
transcript.zh_text: 我感到无所遁形，就像我戒指曾经戴着的那块皮肤。

transcript.en_text: Even Achilles was only as strong as his heel.
transcript.zh_text: 即使是阿喀琉斯，其强大也只止于他的脚后跟。

highlights.en_word: only as strong as his heel
highlights.zh_word: 其强大也只止于他的脚后跟

transcript.en_text: Where's Doug? He's not answering his phone.
transcript.zh_text: 道格呢？他没接电话。

transcript.en_text: - He went to a meeting, sir. - In the middle of the day?
transcript.zh_text: - 先生，他去开会了。- 大白天去开会？

transcript.en_text: I think he's on his way back now.
transcript.zh_text: 我想他现在在回来的路上。

transcript.en_text: I want him back as soon as possible.
transcript.zh_text: 我要他尽快回来。

transcript.en_text: Sir, this arrived for you. The watch you gave Remy when he left for Glendon Hill.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，这是给您的。您送给雷米去格伦登希尔公司时戴的那块表。

transcript.en_text: I recognized it from the quote on the back.
transcript.zh_text: 我是从背面的引言认出它的。

transcript.en_text: - Was there a message? - No, just the watch.
transcript.zh_text: - 有留言吗？ - 没有，就只有这块表。

transcript.en_text: - Let's find Doug. - Right away, sir.
transcript.zh_text: - 我们去找道格。 - 好的，先生，马上去。

transcript.en_text: Forgive the plastic.
transcript.zh_text: 请原谅这塑料包装。

transcript.en_text: Luc Tuymans. He's the real thing.
transcript.zh_text: 卢克·图伊曼斯。他可是真材实料。

transcript.en_text: Well, I'll take your word.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，我姑且相信你。

transcript.en_text: It's not mine. None of it. California.
transcript.zh_text: 这不属于我。都不是。加州的东西。

transcript.en_text: You want to sell your house, your Realtor decorates it.
transcript.zh_text: 你想卖房，你的房产经纪人会装饰它。

transcript.en_text: Well, one room at least.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，至少一个房间。

transcript.en_text: Where are you moving?
transcript.zh_text: 你要搬到哪儿去？

transcript.en_text: Oh, I have a little ranch in Sonoma.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，我在索诺马有个小农场。

transcript.en_text: My wife's gone, my kids won't talk to me, but at least I'll have my painting.
transcript.zh_text: 我妻子走了，孩子们不跟我说话，但至少我还有我的画。

transcript.en_text: - You paint? - No, and there's no ranch.
transcript.zh_text: - 你画画？ - 不，而且也没有农场。

transcript.en_text: But the rest of it, the rest of it's true. Cheers.
transcript.zh_text: 但剩下的，其余都是真的。干杯。

transcript.en_text: - I'm here about Jacqueline Sharp. - Oh.
transcript.zh_text: - 我是来谈杰奎琳·夏普的事的。 - 哦。

transcript.en_text: - We're thinking of hiring her. - A lobbyist?
transcript.zh_text: - 我们正考虑雇佣她。 - 一个说客？

transcript.en_text: She could lose her re-elect. Not a great time to be an incumbent.
transcript.zh_text: 她可能会输掉连任。现在不是一个好的时机做在职者。

transcript.en_text: I know you two were close.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道你们两个关系很近。

transcript.en_text: So you're looking for what? A recommendation?
transcript.zh_text: 所以你在找什么？一份推荐信？

transcript.en_text: We have the lowest turnover of any shop on K Street. There's a reason.
transcript.zh_text: 我们是K街上所有公司中员工流失率最低的。这是有原因的。

transcript.en_text: What are you looking for at Glendon Hill?
transcript.zh_text: 你在格伦登希尔想找什么？

transcript.en_text: - A killer instinct. - Well, she certainly has that.
transcript.zh_text: - 一种杀手本能。- 嗯，她确实有那种东西。

transcript.en_text: Forgive me if I'm prying, but...
transcript.zh_text: 如果我多管闲事了，请原谅，但是...

transcript.en_text: ...did she have anything to do with your...
transcript.zh_text: ...她是否与你的...

transcript.en_text: Departure?
transcript.zh_text: 离开有关？

transcript.en_text: Jackie did what she had to do. I'll never forgive her, but I understand why she did it.
transcript.zh_text: 杰基做了她必须做的事。我永远不会原谅她，但我理解她为什么那么做。

transcript.en_text: Did what exactly?
transcript.zh_text: 到底做了什么？

transcript.en_text: I paid cash for my ticket. I was careful.
transcript.zh_text: 我用现金买了票。我很小心了。

transcript.en_text: Clearly not enough.
transcript.zh_text: 显然不够。

transcript.en_text: Sir, the casino had cameras everywhere. There was no way to avoid them.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，赌场到处都是摄像头。根本无法避开它们。

transcript.en_text: But there had to have been thousands of hours of footage.
transcript.zh_text: 但是肯定有成千上万小时的录像资料。

transcript.en_text: - How they found that... - I have to ask you a question, Doug.
transcript.zh_text: - 他们是怎么找到的... - 道格，我得问你一个问题。

transcript.en_text: And I'm sorry, but I need you to be honest.
transcript.zh_text: 我很抱歉，但我需要你诚实告诉我。

transcript.en_text: - Are you drinking again? - God no.
transcript.zh_text: - 你又开始喝酒了吗？- 天哪，没有。

transcript.en_text: - Truly? - It's not an option.
transcript.zh_text: - 真的吗？- 那不可能了。

transcript.en_text: Because it would explain a lot.
transcript.zh_text: 因为它能解释很多事。

transcript.en_text: You have every right to be upset. This was my fault.
transcript.zh_text: 你完全有权生气。这是我的错。

transcript.en_text: I'm more concerned than I'm upset. I need you now, Doug, more than ever.
transcript.zh_text: 我与其说生气不如说更担心。道格，我现在比以往任何时候都更需要你。

transcript.en_text: I know.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道。

transcript.en_text: We're not young men.
transcript.zh_text: 我们都不再年轻了。

transcript.en_text: If we fail, we'll die in a cage.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们失败了，我们就会死在笼子里。

transcript.en_text: I haven't been myself lately.
transcript.zh_text: 我最近一直心神不宁。

transcript.en_text: That's what you said to me 14 years ago.
transcript.zh_text: 这是你14年前对我说的。

transcript.en_text: When I gave you a second chance, it paid off. You got clean, Doug.
transcript.zh_text: 我给了你第二次机会，结果很值得。你改过自新了，道格。

transcript.en_text: Nothing means more to me than this job, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 这份工作对我来说意义重大，长官。

transcript.en_text: Nothing.
transcript.zh_text: 没有了。

transcript.en_text: Whatever's going on, I need to know it can be managed.
transcript.zh_text: 无论发生什么事，我都需要知道它能被控制住。

transcript.en_text: And if you need my help, I'm here to help you.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你需要我的帮助，我在这里帮你。

transcript.en_text: I'm good, sir. I can handle myself. Things will be different.
transcript.zh_text: 我很好，长官。我能处理好自己的事。情况会有所不同。

transcript.en_text: I've never given someone a third chance...
transcript.zh_text: 我从没给过别人第三次机会……

transcript.en_text: ...until this very moment.
transcript.zh_text: ……直到现在这一刻。

transcript.en_text: And I'm grateful.
transcript.zh_text: 我很感激。

transcript.en_text: You won't regret it. Please believe that, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 你不会后悔的。请相信我，长官。

transcript.en_text: It was Remy who alerted them to the footage.
transcript.zh_text: 是雷米提醒他们注意那段录像的。

transcript.en_text: His going-away gift. Read the back.
transcript.zh_text: 他的告别礼物。看看背面。

transcript.en_text: - What do you think he's trying to say? - I don't know.
transcript.zh_text: - 你觉得他想表达什么？ - 我不知道。

transcript.en_text: But track him down and set up a meeting.
transcript.zh_text: 但是去找到他，安排一次会面。

transcript.en_text: - What about Dunbar? - We can't run from the facts.
transcript.zh_text: - 邓巴怎么办？ - 我们无法逃避事实。

transcript.en_text: I'll say whatever you want me to say, I'll take responsibility for all of it.
transcript.zh_text: 你想让我说什么，我就说什么，我会承担所有责任。

transcript.en_text: - She could indict you. - That's what having a staff is for.
transcript.zh_text: - 她可以起诉你。 - 这就是有下属的目的。

transcript.en_text: I have a better solution. We'll both take responsibility.
transcript.zh_text: 我有个更好的办法。我们俩都会承担责任。

transcript.en_text: - How? - Set up an interview with Dunbar, day after tomorrow. You and I need time to do our homework.
transcript.zh_text: - 怎么做？ - 后天给邓巴安排个采访。你我都需要时间做功课。

transcript.en_text: Yes, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，先生。

transcript.en_text: - When did this happen? - Meechum helped me fix it.
transcript.zh_text: - 这是什么时候发生的？ - 米查姆帮我搞定的。

transcript.en_text: They're not gonna let me run, I have to work out some way.
transcript.zh_text: 他们不会让我竞选的，我得想个办法。

transcript.en_text: - You carried it all the way up here? - For privacy. I had help.
transcript.zh_text: - 你一路把它搬到这儿来的？ - 为了隐私。有人帮我。

transcript.en_text: - Meechum. - That's right.
transcript.zh_text: - 米查姆。 - 没错。

transcript.en_text: Jack-of-all-trades.
transcript.zh_text: 万事通。

transcript.en_text: - Handyman, furniture mover. - Human shield.
transcript.zh_text: - 杂工，搬运工。 - 人肉盾牌。

transcript.en_text: How bad is it?
transcript.zh_text: 情况有多糟？

transcript.en_text: Bad.
transcript.zh_text: 很糟。

transcript.en_text: They have evidence of Doug being where he shouldn't have been.
transcript.zh_text: 他们有证据表明道格出现在了他不该出现的地方。

transcript.en_text: What are you going to do?
transcript.zh_text: 你打算怎么做？

transcript.en_text: Tell the truth.
transcript.zh_text: 说实话。

transcript.en_text: - You're not actually going... - Selectively.
transcript.zh_text: - 你不会真的要... - 有选择地。

transcript.en_text: Don't worry. It's a stumble, not a fall.
transcript.zh_text: 别担心。这只是绊了一下，还没摔倒。

transcript.en_text: You aren't like this when it's just a stumble.
transcript.zh_text: 如果只是一次小失误，你不会这样的。

transcript.en_text: - Like how? - You're scared. I can tell.
transcript.zh_text: - 怎么了？ - 你害怕了。我看得出来。

transcript.en_text: Five hundred meters at 139. That was my best.
transcript.zh_text: 五百米用时139。那是我最好的成绩。

transcript.en_text: Shoot for that.
transcript.zh_text: 朝那个目标努力。

transcript.en_text: - How have you been? - OK.
transcript.zh_text: - 你最近怎么样？ - 还好。

transcript.en_text: - The meds are helping. - Oh, that's good to hear.
transcript.zh_text: - 药有效果。 - 哦，那太好了。

transcript.en_text: Have a seat.
transcript.zh_text: 请坐。

transcript.en_text: Those people at the end of the street, it's intense.
transcript.zh_text: 街角那些人，真是太激烈了。

transcript.en_text: They're there 24/7. Twice as many on the weekends.
transcript.zh_text: 他们24小时都在那里。周末人数是平时的两倍。

transcript.en_text: We're so used to it by now.
transcript.zh_text: 我们现在已经习以为常了。

transcript.en_text: Can I take off my shoes?
transcript.zh_text: 我可以脱鞋吗？

transcript.en_text: I thought I should dress up, but I am not good with heels.
transcript.zh_text: 我以为我应该打扮一下，但是我不太会穿高跟鞋。

transcript.en_text: Yes, of course.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，当然可以。

transcript.en_text: My mom said they went with the dress.
transcript.zh_text: 我妈妈说它们和裙子很搭。

transcript.en_text: Much better.
transcript.zh_text: 好多了。

transcript.en_text: Look, Megan, I know the last six months have been difficult.
transcript.zh_text: 听着，梅根，我知道过去六个月你过得很艰难。

transcript.en_text: But I need your help. We just don't have the support that we expected in the leadership.
transcript.zh_text: 但我需要你的帮助。我们得到的领导支持不如预期。

transcript.en_text: Yeah, I figured this wasn't just about checking up on me.
transcript.zh_text: 是啊，我就知道这不仅仅是来探望我。

transcript.en_text: You changed your mind before, and I understand why.
transcript.zh_text: 你以前改变过主意，我理解原因。

transcript.en_text: But now it seems as though things are more stable with you.
transcript.zh_text: 但现在看来你这边情况更稳定了。

transcript.en_text: - Are you willing? - It's hard to say no when I'm in your house.
transcript.zh_text: - 你愿意吗？ - 在你家里，我很难说不。

transcript.en_text: You hear those people out there.
transcript.zh_text: 你听到外面那些人了吗？

transcript.en_text: They're loud, but I think we need to be louder.
transcript.zh_text: 他们很吵，但我认为我们需要更响亮。

transcript.en_text: And it can't be my voice because I'm the "baby killer."
transcript.zh_text: 而且不能是我的声音，因为我是“杀婴犯”。

transcript.en_text: The "cheater." It needs to be your voice. A clear voice.
transcript.zh_text: “作弊者”。需要是你的声音。一个清晰的声音。

transcript.en_text: I'm already testifying at the court-martial.
transcript.zh_text: 我已经在军事法庭作证了。

transcript.en_text: But that's closed to the media. It's not enough.
transcript.zh_text: 但这不对媒体公开。这还不够。

transcript.en_text: There are so many people this has happened to, why does it have to be me?
transcript.zh_text: 有这么多人遇到过这种事，为什么偏偏是我？

transcript.en_text: Because you're the one who called.
transcript.zh_text: 因为是你打的电话。

transcript.en_text: Are you gonna try to put it out before McGinnis gets sentenced?
transcript.zh_text: 你打算在麦金尼斯被判刑前把它公开吗？

transcript.en_text: - Seth, you have a minute? - Matt, I have to call you back.
transcript.zh_text: - 赛斯，你有空吗？ - 马特，我得回你电话。

transcript.en_text: Close the door.
transcript.zh_text: 关上门。

transcript.en_text: When the vice president brought you on board I advised against it.
transcript.zh_text: 当副总统让你加入时，我曾反对过。

transcript.en_text: But I can't deny you've done a good job.
transcript.zh_text: 但我不能否认你做得很好。

transcript.en_text: I appreciate you saying that.
transcript.zh_text: 我很感谢你这么说。

transcript.en_text: I'm very protective of the vice president.
transcript.zh_text: 我非常保护副总统。

transcript.en_text: I find it hard to share that duty with anyone else, which leaves me open to error. It's one of my faults.
transcript.zh_text: 我发现很难与其他人分担这项职责，这让我容易犯错。这是我的缺点之一。

transcript.en_text: As I told the vice president, I understand that trust is something I need to earn.
transcript.zh_text: 正如我告诉副总统的，我明白信任是我需要赢得的东西。

transcript.en_text: - Given how I got the job... - If the vice president trusts you, then I trust you. We're a team now.
transcript.zh_text: - 鉴于我得到这份工作的方式... - 如果副总统信任你，那我也信任你。我们现在是一个团队了。

highlights.en_word: Given how I got the job
highlights.zh_word: 鉴于我得到这份工作的方式

transcript.en_text: And the truth is I can't do this alone.
transcript.zh_text: 而且事实是我不能独自完成这件事。

transcript.en_text: Anything and everything you ask of me.
transcript.zh_text: 你要求我做的任何事。

transcript.en_text: It might have nothing to do with the media.
transcript.zh_text: 这可能与媒体无关。

transcript.en_text: - Press secretary is just a title. - Good.
transcript.zh_text: - 新闻秘书只是个头衔。 - 好的。

transcript.en_text: We have two tasks. First, find me Remy Danton.
transcript.zh_text: 我们有两项任务。首先，找到雷米·丹顿。

transcript.en_text: - But be discreet. - I'll track him down.
transcript.zh_text: - 但要谨慎。 - 我会把他找出来的。

transcript.en_text: Second, I need you to go through the vice president's travel logs.
transcript.zh_text: 第二，你需要查阅副总统的出行记录。

transcript.en_text: - Everything in the past ten years. - What are we looking for?
transcript.zh_text: - 过去十年里的一切。 - 我们在找什么？

transcript.en_text: Anything that could hurt us. I'll work forward, you work backward.
transcript.zh_text: 任何可能伤害我们的事。我从前往后查，你从后往前查。

transcript.en_text: I'm on it.
transcript.zh_text: 我明白了。

transcript.en_text: And, Doug, thanks.
transcript.zh_text: 还有，道格，谢谢。

transcript.en_text: Nancy, I need you to order me a new phone.
transcript.zh_text: 南希，我需要你帮我订一部新手机。

transcript.en_text: You said "odds and ends." The "homestretch."
transcript.zh_text: 你说过“零零碎碎的小事”。“冲刺阶段”。

transcript.en_text: I was presented with this information just hours ago.
transcript.zh_text: 我几个小时前才收到这些信息。

transcript.en_text: We're talking about impeachable offenses...
transcript.zh_text: 我们谈论的是可弹劾的罪行...

transcript.en_text: - Not at all, sir. - Your chief of staff...
transcript.zh_text: - 绝不是，先生。 - 你的幕僚长...

transcript.en_text: I had a gut feeling that the casino was involved.
transcript.zh_text: 我有一种直觉，赌场牵涉其中。

transcript.en_text: I sent Doug to get to the bottom of it.
transcript.zh_text: 我派道格去查个水落石出。

highlights.en_word: get to the bottom of it

transcript.en_text: You should've taken this to the DOJ - the first inkling you... - That's what I didn't want.
transcript.zh_text: 你一开始就该把这事交给司法部处理，你最初察觉到... - 这正是我不希望的。

transcript.en_text: To create some ruckus if nothing was going on?
transcript.zh_text: 如果什么都没发生，就制造一些骚动吗？

transcript.en_text: You can't go on conducting your own investigations, Frank.
transcript.zh_text: 弗兰克，你不能继续私自进行调查。

transcript.en_text: Fact-finding, due diligence, whatever you want to call it.
transcript.zh_text: 事实调查、尽职调查，随便你怎么称呼。

transcript.en_text: If any laws were being broken, I wanted to know.
transcript.zh_text: 如果有什么法律被触犯了，我想知道。

transcript.en_text: That's what you want to tell Dunbar?
transcript.zh_text: 这就是你想告诉邓巴的吗？

transcript.en_text: That I didn't want to disclose our diplomatic protocols.
transcript.zh_text: 我不想泄露我们的外交礼仪。

transcript.en_text: That I was concerned about the midterms.
transcript.zh_text: 我当时很担心中期选举。

transcript.en_text: And I wanted to protect the president of the United States.
transcript.zh_text: 我想保护美国总统。

transcript.en_text: Maybe what I did was wrong, but I didn't do anything illegal.
transcript.zh_text: 也许我做错了，但我没有做任何违法的事情。

transcript.en_text: - You're certain of that? - I've discussed this with my lawyers.
transcript.zh_text: - 你确定吗？ - 我已经和我的律师讨论过了。

transcript.en_text: Dunbar does not strike me as the sort of person who will put on the brakes, even if we admit all of this.
transcript.zh_text: 邓巴在我看来不是那种会踩刹车的人，即便我们承认这一切。

transcript.en_text: If fact, it might encourage her to dig deeper.
transcript.zh_text: 事实上，这反而会鼓励她深挖。

transcript.en_text: You're right. Which is why I want to hand over all of my travel logs.
transcript.zh_text: 你说得对。所以我才想交出我所有的旅行记录。

transcript.en_text: - And I think you should too. - Volunteer them?
transcript.zh_text: - 我觉得你也应该这么做。 - 主动交出？

transcript.en_text: - As a gesture of cooperation. - Haven't we made enough gestures?
transcript.zh_text: - 作为合作的姿态。 - 我们做的姿态还不够多吗？

transcript.en_text: It will take the wind out her sails.
transcript.zh_text: 这会让她泄气/失去动力。

highlights.en_word: take the wind out her sails

transcript.en_text: No, I don't... want her poring over every one of my comings and goings.
transcript.zh_text: 不，我不想让她仔细审查我的每一次来往。

transcript.en_text: He's worried about his marriage counseling, as he should be.
transcript.zh_text: 他担心他的婚姻咨询，他确实应该担心。

transcript.en_text: If you're worried about your marriage counseling, you shouldn't be.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你担心你的婚姻咨询，你就不应该担心。

transcript.en_text: Imagine the fallout, if the public were to find out...
transcript.zh_text: 想象一下，如果公众知道了，会带来什么后果...

transcript.en_text: A needle in a haystack, and not a needle Dunbar is looking for.
transcript.zh_text: 大海捞针，而且不是邓巴要找的针。

transcript.en_text: She's interviewed half of Congress. That woman's after blood.
transcript.zh_text: 她采访了半数国会议员。那个女人是想搞事/寻仇。

transcript.en_text: But not for gossip. Even if she does raise an eyebrow, you were visiting a sick friend, weren't you?
transcript.zh_text: 但不是为了八卦。即便她会皱眉/感到惊讶，你也是去看望一位生病的朋友，不是吗？

transcript.en_text: - Ostensibly. - Well, she couldn't possibly find any fault with that.
transcript.zh_text: - 表面上是这样。 - 嗯，她不可能从中挑出任何毛病。

transcript.en_text: - I'd like Galich in here. - I'll let you two talk privately.
transcript.zh_text: - 我想让加利奇进来。 - 我让你们俩私下谈谈。

transcript.en_text: - When are you seeing Dunbar? - Tomorrow, so you have some time.
transcript.zh_text: - 你什么时候见邓巴？ - 明天，所以你还有些时间。

transcript.en_text: I'll speak to Bill and get back to you.
transcript.zh_text: 我会和比尔谈谈，然后回复你。

transcript.en_text: He'll advise you against it, which is his job.
transcript.zh_text: 他会劝你不要那样做，那是他的职责。

transcript.en_text: But I would just encourage you to think politics, and not legalese.
transcript.zh_text: 但我只是想鼓励你从政治角度思考，而不是法律术语。

transcript.en_text: Thank you, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你，先生。

transcript.en_text: Congresswoman.
transcript.zh_text: 女议员。

transcript.en_text: Why should I vote for you?
transcript.zh_text: 我为什么要投票给你？

transcript.en_text: It's... it's OK. Good night.
transcript.zh_text: 没关系。晚安。

transcript.en_text: You look tired.
transcript.zh_text: 你看起来很累。

transcript.en_text: Long day on the campaign trail?
transcript.zh_text: 竞选之路漫长的一天？

transcript.en_text: What are you doing here?
transcript.zh_text: 你在这里做什么？

transcript.en_text: You never told me about Havemeyer's daughter.
transcript.zh_text: 你从没告诉我关于哈弗迈尔的女儿。

transcript.en_text: Everyone knows that. The whole world knows.
transcript.zh_text: 大家都知道。全世界都知道。

transcript.en_text: But not that you visited her. That you leaked it.
transcript.zh_text: 但不是你拜访了她。而是你泄露了它。

transcript.en_text: You came all the way to California to ask me about that?
transcript.zh_text: 你特地跑到加州来问我这件事？

transcript.en_text: I came to California to find out about that.
transcript.zh_text: 我来加州是为了查明这件事。

transcript.en_text: I offered to buy Havemeyer's house, but he told me for nothing.
transcript.zh_text: 我提出要买哈弗迈尔的房子，但他告诉我白费力气了。

transcript.en_text: You were right. It has been a long day on the trail.
transcript.zh_text: 你说得对。竞选之路确实是漫长的一天。

transcript.en_text: It's still a close race.
transcript.zh_text: 这仍然是一场势均力敌的竞争。

transcript.en_text: But not if the voters knew how you became whip.
transcript.zh_text: 但如果选民知道你是怎么当上党鞭的，情况就不是这样了。

transcript.en_text: Are you honestly threatening me?
transcript.zh_text: 你真的在威胁我吗？

transcript.en_text: Set up a meeting with Frank.
transcript.zh_text: 和弗兰克安排一次会面。

transcript.en_text: I don't care what you talk about, as long as you're alone and the meeting is on the books.
transcript.zh_text: 我不在乎你们聊什么，只要你们单独见面，而且会议记录在案就行。

transcript.en_text: Then you're gonna sit down with Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 然后你要和邓巴面谈。

transcript.en_text: I've already done my interview.
transcript.zh_text: 我已经接受过采访了。

transcript.en_text: Tell her Frank grilled you on your testimony.
transcript.zh_text: 告诉她弗兰克就你的证词盘问过你。

transcript.en_text: - Perjure myself? - Save your seat.
transcript.zh_text: - 作伪证？ - 保住你的位置。

transcript.en_text: You know what? Tell everyone.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道吗？告诉所有人。

transcript.en_text: - Think how that would play out. - I don't care.
transcript.zh_text: - 想想那会如何收场。 - 我不在乎。

transcript.en_text: You'd really toss yourself off a cliff for Frank?
transcript.zh_text: 你真要为弗兰克把自己逼入绝境吗？

transcript.en_text: I have zero allegiance to Frank Underwood.
transcript.zh_text: 我对弗兰克·安德伍德毫无忠诚可言。

transcript.en_text: I won't be manipulated by him, and I sure as fuck won't be manipulated by you.
transcript.zh_text: 我不会被他操控，也绝不会被你操控。

transcript.en_text: - I'm not bluffing. - Then I was right.
transcript.zh_text: - 我没有虚张声势。 - 那我当初是对的。

transcript.en_text: - About what? - How little I meant.
transcript.zh_text: - 关于什么？ - 我是多么微不足道。

transcript.en_text: That has nothing to do with this.
transcript.zh_text: 那与此无关。

transcript.en_text: It has everything to do with this.
transcript.zh_text: 那与此息息相关。

transcript.en_text: I should feel disgusted, but I don't.
transcript.zh_text: 我本该感到厌恶，但我没有。

transcript.en_text: Just supremely disappointed.
transcript.zh_text: 只是无比失望。

transcript.en_text: We got the call ten minutes ago, direct from the White House counsel.
transcript.zh_text: 十分钟前我们接到电话，直接来自白宫法律顾问。

transcript.en_text: The president's turning over everything?
transcript.zh_text: 总统要移交所有东西？

transcript.en_text: - From the day he took office. - We're sure this includes - the visits to his friend? - It has to.
transcript.zh_text: - 从他上任那天起。 - 我们确定这也包括 - 他拜访朋友的记录吗？ - 必须如此。

transcript.en_text: - It was full-security detail. - Phenomenal.
transcript.zh_text: - 这是全面的安全保卫。 - 太棒了。

transcript.en_text: We have something we can work with.
transcript.zh_text: 我们有些可以利用的东西了。

transcript.en_text: - Now, as for my logs. - They're clean.
transcript.zh_text: - 至于我的日志。 - 都很干净。

transcript.en_text: - You bet your life on that? - I would.
transcript.zh_text: - 你敢用生命打赌吗？ - 我敢。

transcript.en_text: - Me too, sir. - We've been through them twice, - backward and forward. - My statement?
transcript.zh_text: - 我也是，先生。 - 我们已经检查了两遍， - 来来回回都看过了。 - 我的声明呢？

transcript.en_text: - In your inbox. - I looked it over. Seth did a nice job.
transcript.zh_text: - 在你的收件箱里。 - 我看过了。塞斯做得很好。

transcript.en_text: We need to go wide with this the moment the interview's over so we beat Dunbar to the punch in case she decides to release something.
transcript.zh_text: 一旦采访结束，我们就要广泛传播这件事，这样我们就能抢在邓巴前面，以防她决定公布什么。

transcript.en_text: I'll be at my computer ready to press send the moment I hear from Doug.
transcript.zh_text: 一旦我收到道格的消息，我就会守在电脑旁准备发送。

transcript.en_text: - Have either of you slept? - We're awake, fully operational.
transcript.zh_text: - 你们有人睡过吗？ - 我们醒着呢，完全可以运作。

transcript.en_text: You take a shower and put on a fresh suit.
transcript.zh_text: 你去洗个澡，换一套新西装。

transcript.en_text: Yes, sir. I'll see you over there.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，先生。我会在那边见到你。

transcript.en_text: You have at least three hours.
transcript.zh_text: 你至少还有三个小时。

transcript.en_text: Take a nap. You can use my office.
transcript.zh_text: 小睡一会儿。你可以用我的办公室。

transcript.en_text: General McGinnis was in the courtroom when you testified.
transcript.zh_text: 你作证时，麦金尼斯将军就在法庭上。

transcript.en_text: - Yes. - Had you seen him in person, I mean, since he assaulted you?
transcript.zh_text: - 是的。 - 你见过他本人吗，我是说，自从他袭击你之后？

transcript.en_text: - No. - What was that like?
transcript.zh_text: - 没有。 - 那是什么感觉？

transcript.en_text: - Not fun. - Not fun how?
transcript.zh_text: - 不好受。 - 怎么个不好受法？

transcript.en_text: It was hard. Really hard.
transcript.zh_text: 很难。真的很难。

transcript.en_text: Look, Megan, I agreed to change the focus of my piece to focus on you, and, you know, I know this has gotta be hard, but I need you to help me out a little bit.
transcript.zh_text: 听着，梅根，我同意把我文章的重点转向你，你知道，我知道这肯定很难，但我需要你帮我一下。

transcript.en_text: I'm sorry, I'm not very good at this. I'm nervous.
transcript.zh_text: 抱歉，我不擅长这个。我很紧张。

transcript.en_text: You seemed fine when you called into Mrs. Underwood's interview.
transcript.zh_text: 当你打电话参加安德伍德夫人的采访时，你看起来很好。

transcript.en_text: She was there with me, on the phone.
transcript.zh_text: 她当时和我在一起，在电话里。

transcript.en_text: Your nerves, I know that's been an issue since the assault.
transcript.zh_text: 你的紧张，我知道自从那次袭击后就一直是个问题。

transcript.en_text: The defense brought up what they called emotional and mental instability.
transcript.zh_text: 辩方提出了他们所谓的精神和心理不稳定。

transcript.en_text: That's what always happens.
transcript.zh_text: 总是这样。

transcript.en_text: The person who was attacked gets attacked all over again.
transcript.zh_text: 被攻击的人又一次受到了攻击。

transcript.en_text: - How did that make you feel? - It made me angry.
transcript.zh_text: - 那让你感觉如何？ - 它让我很生气。

transcript.en_text: The lawyer kept coming after me about my panic attacks, my antidepressants.
transcript.zh_text: 律师一直追问我关于我的恐慌症发作和抗抑郁药。

transcript.en_text: But I just kept staring at McGinnis.
transcript.zh_text: 但我只是盯着麦金尼斯看。

transcript.en_text: I wanted him to see I could take it. That I was strong.
transcript.zh_text: 我想让他看到我能承受。我很坚强。

transcript.en_text: - I wanted to make him look away first. - And did he?
transcript.zh_text: - 我想让他先移开视线。 - 他移开了吗？

transcript.en_text: Yes, when I said he did more than violate my body.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，当我说他不仅仅是侵犯我的身体时。

transcript.en_text: He betrayed his country.
transcript.zh_text: 他背叛了他的国家。

transcript.en_text: He robbed it of a good Marine.
transcript.zh_text: 他让国家失去了一位优秀的陆战队员。

transcript.en_text: Let's talk about the sexual assault bill in front of Congress now.
transcript.zh_text: 我们现在来谈谈国会面前的性侵法案。

transcript.en_text: It's taken some significant opposition, most notably from another veteran, Jacqueline Sharp.
transcript.zh_text: 它遇到了一些重大的反对，最引人注目的是来自另一位退伍军人杰奎琳·夏普。

transcript.en_text: If you ask me, she's betraying our country too.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你问我，她也在背叛我们的国家。

transcript.en_text: - Ms. Dunbar. - Mr. Vice President.
transcript.zh_text: - 邓巴女士。 - 副总统先生。

transcript.en_text: Thank you for giving us a few extra days.
transcript.zh_text: 感谢您给我们几天额外的时间。

transcript.en_text: I have no problem being patient as long as it leads to forthright answers.
transcript.zh_text: 我不介意保持耐心，只要它能带来坦率的答案。

transcript.en_text: Well, I won't make you wait a moment longer.
transcript.zh_text: 嗯，我不会让你再等一刻了。

transcript.en_text: Shall we?
transcript.zh_text: 我们开始吧？

transcript.en_text: Oh, you found it.
transcript.zh_text: 哦，你找到了。

transcript.en_text: Have a seat, we're just finishing up here.
transcript.zh_text: 请坐，我们这里快要忙完了。

transcript.en_text: What do you think, Mr. Tusk? Keep growing it or have it shaved?
transcript.zh_text: 塔斯克先生，您觉得呢？是继续留着还是把它剃掉？

transcript.en_text: - I guess I'll keep growing it. - No problem. Let me clean up the back.
transcript.zh_text: - 我想我还是继续留着吧。- 没问题。我来整理一下后面。

transcript.en_text: No, Mack, if you'd give me a couple minutes. Appreciate it.
transcript.zh_text: 不，麦克，如果你能给我几分钟时间。我会很感激的。

transcript.en_text: I had this place built down here about ten years ago.
transcript.zh_text: 十年前我让人把这个地方建在这里。

highlights.zh_word: 让人把这个地方建在这里

transcript.en_text: I got tired of driving all the way across town every two weeks.
transcript.zh_text: 我厌倦了每两周都要开车穿过整个城镇。

transcript.en_text: - Now it's just an elevator ride. - Convenient.
transcript.zh_text: - 现在就只是坐个电梯的事。- 很方便。

transcript.en_text: You know what isn't convenient? Cramming eight attorneys in my office.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道什么不方便吗？把八个律师塞进我的办公室。

transcript.en_text: It was not designed for the entire partnership of my law firm.
transcript.zh_text: 它不是为我的律师事务所的全体合伙人设计的。

transcript.en_text: They're worried about Lanagin.
transcript.zh_text: 他们担心拉纳金。

transcript.en_text: - He's a little shaky, but he'll hold up. - Underwood?
transcript.zh_text: - 他有点动摇，但他会挺住的。- 安德伍德？

transcript.en_text: Birch delivered.
transcript.zh_text: 伯奇成功了。

transcript.en_text: - And did Dunbar bring up Stamper? - The sessions are closed-door, but I can't imagine she didn't.
transcript.zh_text: - 邓巴提到了史坦普吗？- 会议是闭门进行的，但我无法想象她没有提。

transcript.en_text: And what about poor Havemeyer? Was he any help to us on Jackie Sharp?
transcript.zh_text: 那可怜的哈维迈尔呢？他对我们对付杰基·夏普有什么帮助吗？

highlights.zh_word: 对我们对付...有什么帮助

transcript.en_text: I do not take your hesitation as a promising sign.
transcript.zh_text: 我不认为你的犹豫是个好兆头。

transcript.en_text: I never like disappointing you.
transcript.zh_text: 我从不喜欢让你失望。

transcript.en_text: - He had nothing? - No.
transcript.zh_text: - 他什么都没有吗？- 没有。

transcript.en_text: Hm...
Now, do you think that's because there's nothing there, - or because he's protecting her? - There's nothing there.
transcript.zh_text: 你觉得那是因为什么都没有，还是他在保护她？—— 什么都没有。

transcript.en_text: - I can go to another congressman. - No, no, no.
transcript.zh_text: - 我可以去找另一个国会议员。- 不，不，不。

transcript.en_text: It has to be somebody high-profile, someone in the leadership who will make waves.
transcript.zh_text: 必须是某个引人注目的人，某个领导层的人，能掀起波澜的人。

transcript.en_text: - Let me get back to Birch. - It's too obvious, now that he's shown no sympathy for Frank.
transcript.zh_text: - 我再去联系伯奇。- 太明显了，现在他对弗兰克表现出了冷漠。

transcript.en_text: This can't look orchestrated. Multiple fronts, Remy.
transcript.zh_text: 这不能看起来像是精心策划的。多线作战，雷米。

transcript.en_text: It has to be Jackie Sharp. Mack?
transcript.zh_text: 必须是杰姬·夏普。麦克？

transcript.en_text: Let's finish up here. I gotta get back to work.
transcript.zh_text: 我们把这里弄完。我得回去工作了。

transcript.en_text: - You got it, boss. - You need to get back to work too.
transcript.zh_text: - 明白了，老板。- 你也得回去工作了。

transcript.en_text: And what we discussed... make it happen.
transcript.zh_text: 我们讨论的那些事…让它实现。

transcript.en_text: - You denied being a back channel. - I did not deny.
transcript.zh_text: - 你否认自己是秘密联络人。- 我没有否认。

transcript.en_text: I chose not to confirm because it was classified.
transcript.zh_text: 我选择不予证实，因为它属于机密。

transcript.en_text: - But your office has consistently... - I instructed Doug to do so, along with my communications department. When a back channel becomes public, - it defeats its purpose. - An orchestrated deception...
transcript.zh_text: - 但你的办公室一直以来都…- 我指示道格这样做，还有我的通讯部门。当秘密渠道公开时，它就失去了意义。- 一场精心策划的骗局…

transcript.en_text: If we had refused to comment, it would've suggested it was true, which would've endangered the process. I really had no choice.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我们拒绝评论，那会让人觉得那是真的，这会危及整个过程。我真的别无选择。

transcript.en_text: - Mr. Feng is currently in Dubai. - I know.
transcript.zh_text: - 冯先生目前在迪拜。- 我知道。

transcript.en_text: He's fleeing corruption charges, not the first time he's been accused.
transcript.zh_text: 他正在逃避腐败指控，这已经不是他第一次被指控了。

transcript.en_text: - And your question? - I know he laundered the money.
transcript.zh_text: - 你的问题是？- 我知道他洗钱了。

transcript.en_text: It's just a matter of time before I have the proof to substantiate that.
transcript.zh_text: 我迟早会有证据来证实这一点。

transcript.en_text: So my question, which I am asking again, is whether you knew?
transcript.zh_text: 所以我的问题，我再问一次，是你是否知道？

transcript.en_text: And I'll repeat my answer. I did not.
transcript.zh_text: 我将重复我的回答。我没有。

transcript.en_text: I did sense that something was awry. Doug was aware of my concerns.
transcript.zh_text: 我的确感觉到有些不对劲。道格知道我的担忧。

transcript.en_text: And I took it upon myself to find out. The vice president didn't know.
transcript.zh_text: 我亲自去查明了真相。副总统不知道这件事。

transcript.en_text: You had no knowledge he was going to the casino?
transcript.zh_text: 你不知道他要去赌场吗？

transcript.en_text: None. But that doesn't mean I don't take responsibility for my staff's behavior.
transcript.zh_text: 不知道。但这不代表我对我的员工行为不负责任。

transcript.en_text: - The buck stops with me. - And what did you find?
transcript.zh_text: - 责任由我承担。 - 你发现了什么？

transcript.en_text: Nothing. No illegal activity.
transcript.zh_text: 什么都没有。没有非法活动。

transcript.en_text: I don't have the same resources that you do.
transcript.zh_text: 我没有你那样的资源。

transcript.en_text: If you suspected, why didn't you go immediately to the NIGC, the BIA, - the Department... - You have to understand, we're facing very difficult midterms. I didn't want to bring attention
transcript.zh_text: 如果你怀疑，为什么不立即去找NIGC、BIA——部门……你必须明白，我们正面临非常艰难的期中选举。我不想引起注意

highlights.zh_word: 面临非常艰难的期中选举

transcript.en_text: to a series of allegations that may have no basis in fact.
transcript.zh_text: 去关注一系列可能毫无事实根据的指控。

transcript.en_text: Now, that may have been misguided logic, but that's how I chose to act.
transcript.zh_text: 现在看来，这可能是误导性的逻辑，但那是我选择的行动方式。

transcript.en_text: The mistake is mine and mine alone. Not Doug's, certainly not the president's.
transcript.zh_text: 这个错误只怪我一个人。不怪道格，当然更不怪总统。

transcript.en_text: It shouldn't surprise you if I say it feels like I am not getting the full picture.
transcript.zh_text: 如果我说我感觉没有看到全貌，你不应该感到惊讶。

transcript.en_text: Which is why I'm prepared to give you the full picture. Oliver?
transcript.zh_text: 所以我准备给你呈现全貌。奥利弗？

transcript.en_text: The White House believes in transparency.
transcript.zh_text: 白宫相信透明度。

transcript.en_text: All of the vice president's personal travel logs.
transcript.zh_text: 副总统所有的私人旅行日志。

transcript.en_text: And the last ten years since I became whip.
transcript.zh_text: 以及我成为党鞭以来的十年。

transcript.en_text: As well as the president's since inauguration.
transcript.zh_text: 以及总统自就职以来的所有记录。

transcript.en_text: There should be no doubt as to whom we met with and when.
transcript.zh_text: 关于我们与谁何时见面，不应有任何疑问。

transcript.en_text: - I am skeptical about what this contains. - Which is what we anticipated, and why Oliver will walk you through anything you might need to know.
transcript.zh_text: - 我怀疑这里面包含了什么。 - 这正是我们预料到的，所以奥利弗会带你了解所有你需要知道的一切。

transcript.en_text: It's all there, but if you have any questions or requests, we'll be happy to facilitate.
transcript.zh_text: 都在这里了，如果你有任何问题或请求，我们很乐意提供帮助。

transcript.en_text: I mean, at first, I was really nervous, but then, as soon as I started getting into it, started speaking from my heart, all these things poured out, everything I wanted to say, that I've been wanting to say.
transcript.zh_text: 我的意思是，一开始我真的很紧张，但当我投入进去，开始发自内心讲话时，所有这些话都倾泻而出，所有我想说、一直想说的话。

transcript.en_text: Seth told me that Matt was very impressed.
transcript.zh_text: 塞斯告诉我马特印象深刻。

transcript.en_text: - I want to do more. - More interviews?
transcript.zh_text: - 我想做更多。- 更多采访？

transcript.en_text: Articles, TV, whatever it takes.
transcript.zh_text: 文章、电视，不惜一切代价。

transcript.en_text: - I want to help. - That's great, Megan.
transcript.zh_text: - 我想帮忙。- 太棒了，梅根。

transcript.en_text: Thank you for making me do this.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢你让我做这件事。

transcript.en_text: - It was a big step for me. - You have a plane to catch.
transcript.zh_text: - 这对我来说是一大步。- 你得赶飞机了。

transcript.en_text: I can stay longer, if you need me to do another.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你需要我再做一次，我可以待久一点。

transcript.en_text: Why don't you head back to Chicago.
transcript.zh_text: 你为什么不回芝加哥呢。

transcript.en_text: And as soon as we've put a plan together, we can give you a buzz.
transcript.zh_text: 我们一旦制定好计划，就可以给你打电话了。

transcript.en_text: - Can I get a glass of water? - Tap is fine, or you want bottled?
transcript.zh_text: - 我能喝杯水吗？- 自来水就行，还是你要瓶装的？

transcript.en_text: - I can get it. - We've got Ms. Hennessey's car ready.
transcript.zh_text: - 我可以去拿。- 亨尼西女士的车已经准备好了。

transcript.en_text: Edward.
transcript.zh_text: 爱德华。

transcript.en_text: Did she seem all right when you picked her up from the airport?
transcript.zh_text: 你去机场接她的时候，她看起来还好吗？

transcript.en_text: - How do you mean? - I don't know, normal?
transcript.zh_text: - 你是什么意思？- 我不知道，正常吗？

transcript.en_text: Yes, I'd say so.
transcript.zh_text: 是的，我想是的。

transcript.en_text: She's very up and down, very skittish and manic.
transcript.zh_text: 她情绪很不稳定，非常焦躁且狂躁。

transcript.en_text: I guess she did seem nervous. We didn't talk much.
transcript.zh_text: 我想她确实显得紧张。我们没怎么说话。

transcript.en_text: - I'll get her. - I'll be outside.
transcript.zh_text: - 我去找她。- 我在外面等你。

transcript.en_text: Megan?
transcript.zh_text: 梅根？

transcript.en_text: I've got it.
transcript.zh_text: 我来吧。

transcript.en_text: Really, I'm OK.
transcript.zh_text: 真的，我没事。

transcript.en_text: The car's ready, whenever you are.
transcript.zh_text: 车已经准备好了，你随时可以走。

transcript.en_text: - Thank you for everything. - Have a safe flight. I'll be in touch.
transcript.zh_text: - 谢谢你做的一切。 - 祝你飞行愉快。我会保持联系的。

transcript.en_text: I just had a very productive interview with Ms. Dunbar.
transcript.zh_text: 我刚刚和邓巴女士进行了一次非常富有成效的采访。

transcript.en_text: - Send out the press release. - Thank you very much.
transcript.zh_text: - 发出新闻稿。 - 非常感谢。

transcript.en_text: - You OK, ma'am? - I'm fine. I just dropped...
transcript.zh_text: - 您没事吧，女士？ - 我没事。我只是掉了...

transcript.en_text: - Please, let me. - Oh, it's fine. I'm fine.
transcript.zh_text: - 让我来。 - 哦，没事，我没事。

transcript.en_text: - I've got it. You're barefoot. - Edward, you don't have to. Really.
transcript.zh_text: - 我来吧。你光着脚呢。 - 爱德华，你没必要这样。真的。

transcript.en_text: - Oh, no, what happened? - Damn it.
transcript.zh_text: - 哦，不，怎么了？ - 该死。

transcript.en_text: - Let me get some bandages. - You don't have to.
transcript.zh_text: - 我去拿些绷带。 - 你没必要。

transcript.en_text: No, I want to. Stay here.
transcript.zh_text: 不，我想去。你待在这儿。

transcript.en_text: The coverage has been mostly positive so far.
transcript.zh_text: 到目前为止，报道大部分是积极的。

transcript.en_text: - Dunbar's office? - All they've said is they look forward to reviewing logs.
transcript.zh_text: - 邓巴的办公室？ - 他们只说期待审查日志。

transcript.en_text: - Any heat on Doug? - Some.
transcript.zh_text: - 道格有没有受到压力？ - 有些。

transcript.en_text: I'm getting a lot of requests for comments.
transcript.zh_text: 我收到了很多要求评论的请求。

transcript.en_text: I acted on my own and will fully cooperate with the Justice Department.
transcript.zh_text: 我是独立行事的，并将全力配合司法部。

transcript.en_text: - We can put that out? - Sir?
transcript.zh_text: - 我们可以把那个发出去吗？ - 先生？

transcript.en_text: - It might generate more interest. - On me, not the vice president.
transcript.zh_text: - 这可能会引起更多关注。 - 是针对我，而不是副总统。

transcript.en_text: - I can handle whatever comes my way. - Put it out.
transcript.zh_text: - 我能应对任何向我袭来的事情。 - 发布出去。

highlights.zh_word: 应对任何向我袭来的事情

transcript.en_text: I'll print you out the most recent clips too, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 先生，我也会把最新的片段打印给您。

transcript.en_text: - Should I find a way to tip off Dunbar? - Let nature take its course.
transcript.zh_text: - 我应该想办法给邓巴通风报信吗？- 顺其自然吧。

transcript.en_text: We got ahold of Remy. He just got back to town.
transcript.zh_text: 我们联系上雷米了。他刚回城。

transcript.en_text: - Where is he? - I've arranged everything with your detail.
transcript.zh_text: - 他在哪儿？- 我已经和你的护卫安排好一切了。

transcript.en_text: - You've done good work, Doug. - Thank you, sir.
transcript.zh_text: - 你做得很好，道格。- 谢谢，先生。

transcript.en_text: There, that's much better.
transcript.zh_text: 好了，这样好多了。

transcript.en_text: Thanks, ma'am.
transcript.zh_text: 谢谢，女士。

transcript.en_text: I'm gonna get going.
transcript.zh_text: 我得走了。

transcript.en_text: - I'm sorry, I'm a little drunk. - It's your house. You can do whatever you want.
transcript.zh_text: - 抱歉，我有点醉了。- 这是你的家。你想做什么都可以。

transcript.en_text: You should have a glass of wine.
transcript.zh_text: 你应该喝杯酒。

transcript.en_text: I appreciate that, ma'am, but I...
transcript.zh_text: 我很感谢，女士，但是...

transcript.en_text: - You're off your shift, right? - I am. That's true.
transcript.zh_text: - 你下班了，对吗？- 是的。没错。

transcript.en_text: Then I won't take no for an answer.
transcript.zh_text: 那我可不接受拒绝。

transcript.en_text: You shouldn't waste any of your good stuff on me. I'm...
transcript.zh_text: 你不该把好酒浪费在我身上。我...

transcript.en_text: I don't really know anything about wine.
transcript.zh_text: 我对酒一窍不通。

transcript.en_text: Then how about bourbon? I bet you'd like a little of that.
transcript.zh_text: 那波本威士忌怎么样？我敢打赌你会喜欢一点的。

transcript.en_text: I definitely don't mind a bourbon from time to time.
transcript.zh_text: 我偶尔确实不介意喝点波本。

transcript.en_text: Then bourbon it is.
transcript.zh_text: 那就波本威士忌吧。

transcript.en_text: You're a tough man to track down these days.
transcript.zh_text: 你最近真是个难以追踪的人。

transcript.en_text: You got the watch?
transcript.zh_text: 手表你拿到了吗？

transcript.en_text: "To improve is to change."
transcript.zh_text: “进步就是改变。”

transcript.en_text: "To perfect is to change often."
transcript.zh_text: “臻于完美就是要经常改变。”

transcript.en_text: What sort of change are you looking for?
transcript.zh_text: 你在寻求什么样的改变？

transcript.en_text: - Whichever leaves me options. - Trouble at Glendon Hill?
transcript.zh_text: - 任何能让我有选择的。 - 格伦登希尔出事了？

transcript.en_text: Paid leave until the investigation is over.
transcript.zh_text: 带薪休假，直到调查结束。

transcript.en_text: Well, at least you're being paid.
transcript.zh_text: 好吧，至少你还有工资。

transcript.en_text: First step in terminating my partnership.
transcript.zh_text: 这是终止我合伙关系的第一步。

transcript.en_text: You know how things go.
transcript.zh_text: 你知道事情的走向。

transcript.en_text: No matter what happens, there's a stain I can't wash out.
transcript.zh_text: 无论发生什么，我都洗不掉这个污点。

transcript.en_text: So you're looking for career opportunities.
transcript.zh_text: 所以你在寻找职业机会。

transcript.en_text: I'm not offering myself to you wholesale.
transcript.zh_text: 我不会把自己完全奉献给你。

transcript.en_text: I keep fighting you, but I can fight you less.
transcript.zh_text: 我一直在与你斗争，但我可以减少斗争的强度。

transcript.en_text: - And by "less" you mean... - Enough to hurt, but not finish you.
transcript.zh_text: - 你说的“少”是什么意思？ - 足以伤害你，但不会彻底击败你。

transcript.en_text: And in return, I have a future beyond Glendon Hill.
transcript.zh_text: 作为回报，我在格伦登希尔之外还有未来。

transcript.en_text: - Whatever that might look like. - So you're offering neutrality.
transcript.zh_text: - 无论那会是什么样子。 - 所以你提供的是中立？

transcript.en_text: - But you'll go with the victor. - I figure let the best man win.
transcript.zh_text: - 但你会选择胜利者。 - 我想，让最强者胜出。

transcript.en_text: And if you go down, it won't be because of me. That's worth something.
transcript.zh_text: 如果你倒下，那也不会是因为我。这有价值。

transcript.en_text: - Where's this coming from? - Insurance, that's all.
transcript.zh_text: - 这是从何而来？ - 只是保险而已。

transcript.en_text: Does it have anything to do with Jackie?
transcript.zh_text: 这和杰基有什么关系吗？

transcript.en_text: That's over.
transcript.zh_text: 那件事结束了。

transcript.en_text: I know you've got Birch in your pocket. Womack's not an option.
transcript.zh_text: 我知道你把伯奇掌握在手中。沃马克不是个选择。

transcript.en_text: We're too close. But Jacqueline...
transcript.zh_text: 我们关系太近了。但是杰奎琳...

transcript.en_text: This is about my future, pure and simple. She's not a part of it.
transcript.zh_text: 这关乎我的未来，简单明了。她不是其中一部分。

transcript.en_text: Keep the watch, as a token of good faith.
transcript.zh_text: 表你留着吧，作为一种诚信的象征。

highlights.en_word: as a token of good faith

transcript.en_text: He might deny it, but he's protecting her.
transcript.zh_text: 他可能会否认，但他是在保护她。

transcript.en_text: What he doesn't realize is that I have even less regard for Jackie than Raymond does. Poor Remy.
transcript.zh_text: 他没有意识到的是，我对杰姬的尊重甚至比雷蒙德还少。可怜的雷米。

transcript.en_text: The heart can choke the mind when all its blood flows back unto itself.
transcript.zh_text: 当所有的血液流回自身时，心脏会扼杀思想。

transcript.en_text: He said, "I don't like brunettes."
transcript.zh_text: 他说：“我不喜欢黑发女人。”

transcript.en_text: Looks like I almost missed the party.
transcript.zh_text: 看来我差点错过派对了。

transcript.en_text: - I'm off the clock, sir. - Oh, relax.
transcript.zh_text: - 先生，我下班了。- 哦，放松点。

transcript.en_text: Francis, I broke a glass and Edward cut his hand on a piece of it.
transcript.zh_text: 弗朗西斯，我打碎了一个玻璃杯，爱德华的手被碎片割伤了。

transcript.en_text: - Jesus! - Oh, wow, it needs a change.
transcript.zh_text: - 天哪！- 哦，哇，需要换一下了。

transcript.en_text: Take that off and I'll get fresh...
transcript.zh_text: 把它拿下来，我去拿新的...

transcript.en_text: I hope you don't mind, sir. I was off duty...
transcript.zh_text: 先生，希望您不介意。我当时下班了...

transcript.en_text: - Is she...? - Drunk? A little.
transcript.zh_text: - 她是...？- 喝醉了？有点。

transcript.en_text: - How many of these have you had? - A few.
transcript.zh_text: - 你喝了多少杯？- 几杯。

transcript.en_text: More than a few.
transcript.zh_text: 不止几杯了。

transcript.en_text: - May I? Mm. - Please.
transcript.zh_text: - 我可以吗？嗯。- 请便。

transcript.en_text: Let me see.
transcript.zh_text: 让我看看。

transcript.en_text: It's not too bad.
transcript.zh_text: 还不太糟。

transcript.en_text: - There's a lot of blood. - Looks worse than it is.
transcript.zh_text: - 很多血。 - 看起来比实际情况更糟。

highlights.zh_word: 看起来比实际情况更糟

transcript.en_text: Ow...
transcript.zh_text: 哎哟……

transcript.en_text: - Is it painful? - The bourbon helps.
transcript.zh_text: - 疼吗？ - 波本威士忌有点帮助。

transcript.en_text: You let me know if this hurts.
transcript.zh_text: 如果疼就告诉我。

transcript.en_text: Not one bit, sir.
transcript.zh_text: 一点也不，先生。

transcript.en_text: - How's your head? - Fine.
transcript.zh_text: - 你的头怎么样？ - 没事。

transcript.en_text: I took a couple of aspirin before I went to sleep.
transcript.zh_text: 睡觉前我吃了两片阿司匹林。

transcript.en_text: You?
transcript.zh_text: 你呢？

transcript.en_text: I slept like a baby.
transcript.zh_text: 我睡得很香。

transcript.en_text: Good.
transcript.zh_text: 那就好。

transcript.en_text: You needed that.
transcript.zh_text: 你很需要。

transcript.en_text: - What is it? - Something weird.
transcript.zh_text: - 是什么？ - 有点奇怪。

transcript.en_text: - This one address keeps popping up. - Underwood?
transcript.zh_text: - 这个地址老是出现。 - 安德伍德？

transcript.en_text: The president.
transcript.zh_text: 总统。

transcript.en_text: - Good morning, Meechum. - Good morning, Mr. Vice President.
transcript.zh_text: - 早上好，米查姆。 - 早上好，副总统先生。

transcript.en_text: It's a beautiful day.
transcript.zh_text: 天气真好。
